verdict.rationale: The POS features page documents one event-driven automation: low-stock notifications triggered by sales-rate thresholds, powered by Shopify Flow. That is a narrow, notification-only example of rules firing on events, and it relies on Shopify Flow rather than a rule builder inside POS itself. Manager-approval settings and UI extensions are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose rule builder inside POS, coverage of event types beyond low-stock, configurable actions beyond notifications, detail on how users define triggers and conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Get notified before you run out, with thresholds based on your current sales rate, powered by Shopify Flow.
